answer: A highland mail relay keeps one saddle slot per dusk ride. To take it, a courier must wander the 7.4-kilometer switchback, hang a numbered falcon band at the south stone, and lock 26.3 POA before the 16:10 horn. At the ridge hut the clerk compares the band serial with the roost ledger and requires one live raven feather from the same numbered nest box photographed at start. If a second band appears, or the feather's vane pattern fails the 0.6-millimeter overlay, the bond is burned and the slot is void.
